photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
If you apply with a paper application, an official passport photo for India should be

  • 35mm-40mm wide and 45mm-50mm high,
  • your head must be a maximum of 36mm and a minimum of 32mm from chin to crown.

If you apply for an official document online, the digital photo should match the printed photo in size and all other requirements.

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
Can you have a fringe in a passport photo?

It depends on the document type. Official documents that are used for biometrical machine reading (electronic passports, visas, identity cards) don’t allow fringe because it makes it harder to read the biometrical data from the scan. Then fringe must be sided to either side and pinned down with unnoticeable bobby pins.

However, more casual identity documents like a student card, or transportation card can have a passport photo with a fringe.
If you are not sure about the requirements, you can use Smartphone iD service that will get you a conform and checked photo for the document of your choice.

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon: Not all governments allow glasses because it’s very hard to get it right. Thick frames are forbidden, as well as tinted glass, no reflection can appear, and they must sit correctly. Therefore, those governments who don’t forbid wearing glasses, highly suggest taking them off for the photo.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: Can you wear glasses in a passport photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
Yes, you can wear makeup in your passport photo.

  • But note that make-up should be light. Don’t put too much eyeshadow on your eyelids.
  • Often glossy lipstick might create a reflection, therefore, better opt for a matte lipstick, if you want to accent your lips.
  • It’s useful also to check that your skin is not oily before taking a photo, as it can create a light reflection, too.
  • Finally, remember that the passport photo must be as natural as possible and must resemble you on a regular day.

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon: In most cases, you will need to take a new photo when it comes to renewing your passport. The only exception is if your passport has been damaged, lost, or destroyed. For Indian official documents, photos cannot be older than 6 months.
